correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt both modular cycle-and-rung graphs and checked the exact displayed sets against the open-neighborhood conditions: every vertex, selected or not, has a selected neighbor, and all 9 and 13 outside signatures respectively are distinct. For any cubic graph on N vertices and locating-total set of size k, at most k outsiders have singleton signatures, so at least 2(N−k)−k incidences cross the cut. At most 2k cross it from the selected side by total domination there. Thus 5k≥2N; N=16,22 give matching lower bounds 7,9, with no exhaustive subset search needed. The record's statement of Conjecture 2, independently corroborated by two later treatments of the same invariant, predicts 8 and 10. The numerical values and the bound are independently proved; the conjecture comparison has the primary-access qualification recorded below.
